blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The chapter provides a comprehensive overview of historical personalities associated with Tripura.
It covers modern personalities who contributed to the socio-cultural landscape of the state.
Special focus is given to S.D. Burman, highlighting his musical legacy and connection to Tripura.

cells: Greatest Manikya king; introduced printing press; abolished slavery; built roads; promoted education; modernised Tripura; close ties with Bengali literary renaissance
Built Ujjayanta Palace (1901); sent sons to study in England; Agartala became planned city
Built Neermahal; introduced modern education; Agartala airport built during his time; progressive ruler
Signed Merger Agreement with India; peaceful merger; preserved Tripura's identity
Born in Agartala (royal family); legendary Bollywood music director and singer; 'Hai Apna Dil to Awara', 'Sun Mere Bandhu Re'; Padma Bhushan; one of India's greatest composers
Tagore visited Tripura multiple times; royal family were his patrons; wrote poems here; 'Bisarjan' inspired by Tripura; Tripura's connection with Tagore is celebrated

blocks.content: S.D. Burman — Tripura's Gift to Hindi Cinema

cells: Born Agartala 1906; legendary Bollywood music director; composed for Guru Dutt, Dev Anand, Rajesh Khanna; Padma Bhushan 1969; 'Aradhana', 'Guide', 'Jewel Thief' music; one of greatest composers of Hindi cinema
Son of S.D. Burman; 'Pancham Da'; legendary composer of disco era and beyond; 'Hare Rama Hare Krishna', 'Sholay', 'Amar Prem'; not born in Tripura but connected through father's origin

Chief Minister 1998–2018 (20 years); iconic for personal simplicity; declared his total assets as one pair of sandals and a few thousand rupees in bank account at one point; led Tripura to highest literacy in NE India
Royal scion; founded TIPRA Motha (2021); champion of tribal rights; demands 'Greater Tipraland' for tribal communities; won 13 seats in 2023 elections
First Indian woman to compete in gymnastics at Olympics (Rio 2016); famous for performing the Produnova vault (one of most dangerous vaults); Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna; Padma Shri; born Agartala
Born in Vijayawada but trained in Tripura; doubles specialist; Arjuna Award; represented India internationally; married to cricketer Chetan Bhagat (actor)
Bengali literature from Tripura; Sahitya Akademi recognition
Famous comedian-actor of Bengali films and TV; born Tripura
Pioneer of Kokborok literature; preservation of tribal traditions

blocks.content: NOTE: Dipa Karmakar from Agartala is Tripura's most celebrated sportsperson. At the 2016 Rio Olympics, she became the first Indian woman gymnast to compete in Olympics, narrowly missing a medal (finished 4th in vault final). Her Produnova vault — considered one of the most dangerous vaults in gymnastics — was performed flawlessly. She is an inspiration for youth across northeast India.
11.3 S.D. Burman — Tripura's Gift to Hindi Cinema

items: Identify the major royal and historical personalities of Tripura frequently asked in state PSC exams.
Remember S.D. Burman's royal lineage from Tripura and his contributions to the Hindi cinema music industry.

blocks.content: Sachin Dev Burman (1906–1975), popularly known as S.D. Burman or 'Dada Burman', is Tripura's most celebrated cultural personality. Born in Agartala into the royal family (he was related to the Manikya dynasty), he went to Calcutta and then Bombay to pursue music. He composed music for over 90 Hindi films spanning five decades.

items: Royal connection: He was related to the Manikya royal family of Tripura
Music training: Classical music in Calcutta; influenced by folk music of Tripura and Bengal
Famous films: 'Baazi' (1951), 'Guide' (1965, won Filmfare Award), 'Aradhana' (1969), 'Abhimaan' (1973), 'Amar Prem' (1972)
Awards: Padma Bhushan (1969), Filmfare Lifetime Achievement; numerous Filmfare Awards
Son: Rahul Dev Burman (R.D. Burman/'Pancham Da') — equally legendary; the father-son duo are Hindi cinema's greatest musical legacy
Tripura connection: He frequently used folk melodies from Tripura and Bengal; his music has a distinctive warmth and simplicity
